name: The Sable Charter Variations
description: A Vantablack Media tentpole depicting the founding of the Sable Charter corponation through the eyes of its mythologized first CEO, Harmon Voss II. Viewers inhabit three simultaneous protagonists across 140 minutes of full sensory immersion, experiencing the 'heroic sacrifice' of early corporate settlers. Produced with a Φ340 million budget, it remains the highest-grossing neural-feed film of the 2190s.
cultural_impact: Rehabilitated the Sable Charter's founding mythology for a generation of Tier 2 workers who had grown up hearing only the atrocity accounts, and sparked a decade of counter-documentaries.
story_hooks: A researcher discovers that one of the three 'heroic' POV characters was a real person — a Shelf organizer whose life was stolen and inverted for the film
The original cut, containing a 22-minute sequence depicting forced labor camps, was rumored to exist on a physical drive somewhere in the Shelf
A runner is hired to deliver a data chip that may contain sworn depositions from extras who witnessed something on the production set
